exposure: increased intake of lactose, fiber, magnesium, zinc, B3, B5
cohort: 170 women undergoing in vitro fertilization (IVF) who were pregnant and divided into intervention and control groups.
finding: A diet modification program during pregnancy significantly reduced the prevalence of preeclampsia among IVF-pregnant women, but did not significantly affect gestational diabetes mellitus, cesarean delivery, preterm delivery, intrauterine growth retardation, birth weight, or fetal viability.
mod_finding: No significant difference in cesarean delivery rates was found between the intervention and control groups (94.1-95.2%).
